response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong software development skills and a broad range of experience, particularly in full-stack and tooling development. However, his background lacks direct experience in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator optimization, or hardware-software co-design, which are critical for this role. His expertise in AI-agent infrastructure and performance-focused projects (e.g., low-latency apps) shows potential, but the fit is not immediately clear.
strengths: Extensive experience in performance-sensitive systems (e.g., low-latency apps, real-time data processing).
Diverse technical background spanning embedded systems, cloud infrastructure, and developer tooling.
Strong open-source contributions and leadership in technical communities (e.g., workshops, talks).
concerns: No direct experience with SoC/IP modeling or AI accelerator hardware optimization.
Lacks explicit GPU architecture or deep neural network training/inference optimization experience.
Most roles emphasize software development over hardware-software co-design or system architecture.
